profile.name: Cassiopeia J P
profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Citizens Advice SORT
profile.bio: I build digital tools with TypeScript, Next.js, Python, and FastAPI. Day to day I work with developers and non-developers at Citizens Advice SORT in Manchester. Outside work I make art and write.

experience.summary: Part of a team building and shipping digital solutions with TypeScript, Next.js, Python, and FastAPI, through AWS and GCP with a focus on AI solutions to supporting charity work.

achievements.text: Helped lay the foundations SCPs (Simulated Client Personas) in a new agentic training platform, having a basis in voice to text transcription and evaluation.
Helped to build a platform with the pupose of supporting clients in their PIP journey, tool aimed to be a gateway to an appointment and is projected to reduce appointment times by 60%.

Handled design, development and architecture documentation for the various projects that the team worked on, laying the groundwork for further development as well as championing the usage of the GitHub project boards as a means to manage tasks and issues.
Attended shareholder meetings to converse and network with funders regarding the future of the fund and the direction of the project using the funding they awarded us.
Championed the necessity of a rebuild to the internal expenses app and led the development of the new app using React and Node.js with a python backend and Firebase database.
Created the initial accessibility feature for two of the training platforms whilst pushing to be allowed to implement such features across the entire catalogue of products we build/work on.

experience.summary: Supported staff with CRM and site issues, set up an online tutor schedule, and handled marketing tasks and hardware upkeep. Worked in a team to ensure the store was running smoothly and efficiently, whilst fostering a positive and supportive work environment.

achievements.text: Helped handle the research and outreach to potential clients, as well as the setup and management of the online tutor schedule.
Handled the CRM and site updates, as well as the general upkeep of the website and CRM system.
Handled marketing tasks, such as advert design and coordinated with the marketing manager to push to distribution channels.

experience.summary: Volunteer work on a print magazine for the group's 20th anniversary: designed assets and edited copy for readability.

achievements.text: Designed print assets for the 20th anniversary magazine, including the cover, layout, and content.
Drafted and edited copy for clearer reading, ensuring the content was engaging, informative and truthful.
Worked with a volunteer group through to print, ensuring the magazine was produced to a high standard and on time.

experience.summary: Prepared and served food, including drive-thru delivery, plus standard cleaning duties.

achievements.text: Prepared and served food, primarily focusing on bad of house work such as fry cooking, plus standard cleaning duties.
Worked in a team to ensure the store was running smoothly and efficiently, whilst fostering a positive and supportive work environment.

education.summary: Software Development pathway while working full-time, studying part-time and working full-time. Dropped out when I realised I was not learning as much as I would have liked to and wanted to focus on building my own projects and skills.

Two-year technical qualification with industry placement and project work, focusing on digital production, design and development culminating in a 70hr project based on a real client's needs including a full stack website and documentation.

achievements.text: Completed T-Level in Digital Production, Design and Development with passing grades in all modules.
Completed a 70hr project based on a real client's needs including a full stack website and documentation. gaining a passing grade in the project.
Learnt the basics of HTML, CSS, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python Database Management Systems and SQLite.
Completed 360hrs of industry placement in a real client's business, gaining valuable experience and insights into the industry.

education.summary: Core academic subjects offered by the school, part of the required curriculum for schools in the UK.
Creative subjects alongside GCSEs offered by the school, part of the elective curriculums offered by schools in the UK.

achievements.text: Completed the Creative iMedia course work within the 1st 6 months of the 2 year course, whilst still gaining a distinction at level 2.

Handled the Art, Craft and Design (3D Design) course work, including the planning and creation of a physical model of the planned product despite having our teacher be injured early into the course and being missing for a majority of the course.
Completed the Art, Craft and Design course work, gaining a grade 4, with a focus on multi-media production and design.
